title: Syrian Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with cabbage and slow-cooked to perfection, perfect for a sick day. This dish is a traditional Syrian recipe with a Jewish twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the shredded cabbage, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the lemon juice and 4 cups of water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the stew gently over low heat, adding a little water if necessary, to prevent scorching.
